subject: Annual planning: goal anchors & scenario labs
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual planning: goal anchors & scenario labs
Cc: 

Team —

Kicking off the annual planning workbench. I attached a first-pass workbook (planning_templates_v1.xlsx) to help us capture goal anchors, scenario inputs, and decision triggers. High-level ask: over the next two business weeks we should arrive at a set of 2–3 prioritized scenarios (baseline, upside, constrained) plus a sensitivity matrix for key levers (retention, ARPU, hiring cadence, lead conversion).

Proposed lightweight timeline:
- Week 1 (7/12–7/18): owners capture assumptions + initial model runs
- Week 2 (7/19–7/25): variant runs, sensitivity bands, and consolidation
- Week 3 (7/26–8/1): leadership review + QBR package prep

Immediate requests:
1) Please nominate scenario owners by EOD Tuesday (7/14).
2) Fill tab "assumptions_master" in the attached workbook with primary sources and confidence levels.
3) If anyone needs customer cohorts or billing slices, call it out in replies and I'll route to CS/Finance.

I propose a 45-minute sync on Thu 7/15 at 10:00 PT to align on owners and reporting cadence. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Why this matters: we want a compact set of scenarios we can reproducibly run against the same prompts and cost model so product and finance can converge on tradeoffs quickly.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Financial Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachment: planning_templates_v1.xlsx (workbook stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: goal anchors & scenario labs

Thanks, Olga — this looks good and pragmatic. Quick thoughts:
- Keep scenarios tightly scoped to the 3-way split (baseline / upside / constrained). We should also run a "sensitivity band" test for retention +/- 2 pts and ARPU +/- 10%.
- Proposed owners: Jonas -> ops/infrastructure assumptions, Marissa -> revenue & bookings, Mina -> people/headcount glidepath. Marcus can own the opex details.
- 7/15 10:00 PT works for me; please send calendar invite.

One small ask: can we explicitly call out any forced constraints (e.g., hiring freeze windows) so model runs are comparable?

Vivek
CEO, Redwood Inference

Note: I'll loop in Sales and CS where we need cohort-level inputs after owners land their lists.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: goal anchors & scenario labs

Agreed on owners. A couple of operational dependencies to call out:
- Market pricing sensitivity: we should overlay a pricing shock (enterprise compression) in one variant.
- Capacity/throughput assumptions: product needs a token-cost view per common route so finance can convert to unit economics. I'll add a tab to the doc for token-level driver mapping.

Working doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-scenario-labs — I'll add a section "ops assumptions" and invite SRE/product to contribute.

I'll plan to run two model passes (coarse + refined) and share results by 7/19.

— Jonas
VP, Platform Ops

Thanks all — summary and action items below.

Decisions taken:
- Scenario slate: Baseline / Upside / Constrained (pricing shock variant on constrained).
- Owners: Jonas (ops), Marissa (revenue), Mina (people), Marcus (opex).
- Hiring constraint for constrained scenario: hiring pause 9/1–12/31.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- All owners: populate "assumptions_master" tab in planning_templates_v1.xlsx by 7/17 (linked in drive).
- Jonas: upload token-cost mapping and run coarse model by 7/19.
- Marissa: push cohort tables and conversion lift assumptions by 7/17 (Anna from Acme to share cohorts).
- Mina: finalize headcount glidepaths and role-level ramp by 7/17 (attached csv).
- Marcus: provide opex detail and run sensitivity to cloud spend by 7/21.

Next meeting: Thu 7/15 10:00 PT — 45 minutes (calendar invite sent).

I'll consolidate inputs and publish planning_templates_v2.xlsx by EOD Wed 7/15.

Thanks again — keeping this tight and reproducible is the priority.

Olga Petrov
